notes.title: Update V.023
notes.content:
-You can choose which story/level you want to play from the menu!
-Loading time for the game to load is faster
-More levels are now available and older fixed
-Bugs & fixes

notes.title: Version 2 is now available
notes.content:
bug fixes and now you can choose levels in main menu ( skip intro) or just skip to the next level if you are stuck, try other levels  etc..
some secrets added is levels 2 -8 ( intro does not have secrets).
